mainEntity.name: What exactly is basement drywall finishing, and do I need it before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall finishing is the step that makes hung drywall look smooth, seamless, and ready for primer and paint. For a basement, it usually includes taping seams, applying joint compound, sanding, and choosing the right finish level for the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement drywall finishing smooths taped seams and screw marks so the walls are paint-ready. If you want a clean, durable basement interior, finishing is the step that comes before primer and paint.
